concepts.name: Vestibular schwannoma clinical presentation
concepts.blurb: Unilateral progressive sensorineural hearing loss, tinnitus, and disequilibrium from a vestibular nerve tumor.

concepts.name: Audiometry and word recognition in VS
concepts.blurb: Pure-tone audiometry and word recognition define AAO-HNS/Gardner-Robertson hearing class guiding preservation strategy.

concepts.name: Vestibular schwannoma MRI features
concepts.blurb: Enhancing intracanalicular mass widening the IAC with an ice-cream-cone CPA component on gadolinium MRI.

concepts.name: Koos grading of vestibular schwannoma
concepts.blurb: Koos grades I-IV stratify VS by extrameatal extension and brainstem contact, guiding management.

concepts.name: Observation and serial imaging of VS
concepts.blurb: Wait-and-scan for small or minimally growing tumors, tracking growth on interval MRI and hearing.

concepts.name: Stereotactic radiosurgery for VS
concepts.blurb: Single-fraction SRS controls small-to-moderate tumors with high tumor control and good hearing/facial preservation.
acgme: Stereotactic Radiosurgery for Brain Tumors (Gamma Knife CyberKnife)

concepts.name: Microsurgical resection of VS
concepts.blurb: Resection for large or brainstem-compressing tumors, balancing extent against facial and hearing function.

concepts.name: Hearing preservation strategy in VS
concepts.blurb: Serviceable hearing (50/50 rule) favors retrosigmoid or middle fossa over hearing-sacrificing translabyrinthine.

concepts.name: Facial nerve outcomes after VS surgery
concepts.blurb: Facial weakness is the key morbidity; anatomic preservation and tumor size predict House-Brackmann recovery.

concepts.name: VS approach selection
concepts.blurb: Retrosigmoid, translabyrinthine, or middle fossa chosen by tumor size, IAC fundus extent, and hearing status.

concepts.name: NF2-associated bilateral vestibular schwannoma
concepts.blurb: Bilateral VS is pathognomonic for NF2; management prioritizes hearing, brainstem auditory implants, and bevacizumab.
acgme: Neuropathology of Developmental and Genetic Disorders (Tuberous Sclerosis NF1 or NF2)

concepts.name: Intraoperative facial nerve monitoring
concepts.blurb: Continuous facial EMG and stimulation localize and protect CN VII during CPA tumor dissection.

concepts.name: Cerebellopontine angle mass differential
concepts.blurb: Vestibular schwannoma, meningioma, and epidermoid account for most CPA masses with distinct imaging signatures.

concepts.name: CPA schwannoma vs meningioma imaging
concepts.blurb: Schwannoma centers on and widens the IAC; meningioma is dural-based, eccentric, with a dural tail and calcification.

concepts.name: CPA epidermoid vs arachnoid cyst
concepts.blurb: Epidermoid restricts on DWI and is bright on FLAIR; arachnoid cyst follows CSF and does not restrict.

concepts.name: Skull base meningioma imaging features
concepts.blurb: Homogeneously enhancing dural-based mass with dural tail, hyperostosis, and CSF cleft from adjacent brain.

concepts.name: Sphenoid wing meningioma
concepts.blurb: Medial (clinoidal), lateral, and en plaque variants; medial lesions threaten optic nerve and cavernous sinus.

concepts.name: Spheno-orbital meningioma
concepts.blurb: En plaque meningioma with hyperostotic sphenoid wing causing proptosis; resection targets bone and orbital decompression.

concepts.name: Olfactory groove meningioma
concepts.blurb: Anterior cranial fossa midline meningioma causing anosmia and Foster Kennedy syndrome; often large at presentation.
acgme: Skull Base Meningioma (Petroclival Sphenoid Wing Olfactory Groove)

concepts.name: Tuberculum sellae meningioma and vision
concepts.blurb: Suprasellar meningioma causing chiasmal compression; early resection preserves vision and timing predicts recovery.

concepts.name: Petroclival meningioma
concepts.blurb: High-morbidity posterior fossa meningioma medial to CN V; subtotal resection plus SRS often safer than radical removal.
acgme: Skull Base Meningioma (Petroclival Sphenoid Wing Olfactory Groove)

concepts.name: Foramen magnum meningioma
concepts.blurb: Ventral or ventrolateral craniocervical junction meningioma causing myelopathy; far lateral approach for ventral lesions.

concepts.name: Cavernous sinus meningioma philosophy
concepts.blurb: Aggressive resection risks cranial neuropathy and carotid injury; radiosurgery is preferred for most cavernous lesions.

concepts.name: Extent of resection in skull base meningioma
concepts.blurb: Simpson grade and recurrence risk are balanced against cranial nerve and vascular morbidity at the skull base.

concepts.name: Endonasal corridor anatomy
concepts.blurb: Sphenoid sinus landmarks, sellar floor, carotid and optic prominences, and opticocarotid recess define the corridor.
acgme: Sellar and Parasellar Anatomy - Pituitary Cavernous Sinus Optic Chiasm

concepts.name: Standard sellar transsphenoidal exposure
concepts.blurb: Binostril endoscopic approach opening sphenoid and sellar floor for intrasellar lesions like pituitary adenoma.
acgme: Endoscopic Transsphenoidal Surgery for Pituitary Tumors

concepts.name: Extended transplanum-transtuberculum approach
concepts.blurb: Suprasellar corridor for tuberculum meningioma and craniopharyngioma, opening planum sphenoidale above the sella.

concepts.name: Endonasal transclival approach
concepts.blurb: Midline corridor through the clivus to ventral brainstem and posterior fossa for chordoma and clival lesions.

concepts.name: Endonasal transcribriform approach
concepts.blurb: Anterior corridor through the cribriform plate for olfactory groove lesions and esthesioneuroblastoma resection.

concepts.name: Endonasal transpterygoid approach
concepts.blurb: Lateral expansion through the pterygopalatine fossa reaching Meckel's cave, petrous apex, and lateral recess.

concepts.name: Nasoseptal flap reconstruction
concepts.blurb: Vascularized Hadad-Bassagasteguy flap on the posterior septal artery is the workhorse for skull base reconstruction.

concepts.name: Endonasal CSF leak repair and reconstruction
concepts.blurb: Multilayer closure with fascia, fat, gasket-seal, and nasoseptal flap prevents postoperative CSF rhinorrhea.

concepts.name: Internal carotid artery injury management
concepts.blurb: Catastrophic endonasal complication managed by packing and tamponade, then angiography for sacrifice or stenting.

concepts.name: DI and endocrine complications after endonasal surgery
concepts.blurb: Diabetes insipidus, SIADH triphasic response, and hypopituitarism require close sodium and hormone monitoring.
acgme: Diabetes Insipidus - Post-Pituitary or Skull Base Surgery and TBI

concepts.name: Endonasal surgery complications overview
concepts.blurb: CSF leak, meningitis, epistaxis, anosmia, and visual injury are the principal endonasal corridor risks.

concepts.name: Clival chordoma
concepts.blurb: Midline notochordal remnant tumor with physaliphorous cells and brachyury positivity; locally aggressive, bone-destructive.

concepts.name: Skull base chondrosarcoma
concepts.blurb: Off-midline petroclival synchondrosis tumor with chondroid matrix; better prognosis than chordoma.

concepts.name: Chordoma vs chondrosarcoma discrimination
concepts.blurb: Chordoma is midline; chondrosarcoma is off-midline at the petroclival fissure with arc-and-ring calcification.

concepts.name: Proton beam therapy for chordoma
concepts.blurb: High-dose proton or particle therapy after maximal resection improves local control with steep dose falloff near brainstem.

concepts.name: En bloc resection philosophy
concepts.blurb: Maximal safe, ideally en bloc, resection limits seeding and recurrence but is constrained by skull base anatomy.

concepts.name: Glomus jugulare paraganglioma
concepts.blurb: Hypervascular paraganglioma of the jugular bulb with salt-and-pepper MRI and possible catecholamine secretion.

concepts.name: Fisch classification of glomus tumors
concepts.blurb: Fisch types A-D stratify temporal bone paraganglioma by tympanic, mastoid, and intracranial extension.

concepts.name: Glasscock-Jackson classification
concepts.blurb: Separates glomus tympanicum from glomus jugulare by site and extent across the temporal bone.

concepts.name: Lower cranial nerve syndromes
concepts.blurb: Jugular foramen (Vernet) and Collet-Sicard syndromes from CN IX-XII compromise cause dysphagia, hoarseness, and aspiration.

concepts.name: Jugular foramen lesion differential
concepts.blurb: Paraganglioma, schwannoma, and meningioma differ by vascularity, bone margins, and flow voids on imaging.

concepts.name: Jugular foramen lesion management
concepts.blurb: Preoperative embolization, radiosurgery, or staged resection balanced against lower cranial nerve morbidity.

concepts.name: Petrous apex cholesterol granuloma
concepts.blurb: Expansile cystic lesion bright on both T1 and T2 MRI from repeated hemorrhage and cholesterol crystal reaction.

concepts.name: Petrous apex cholesteatoma (epidermoid)
concepts.blurb: Congenital epidermoid that is T1 dark, T2 bright, and restricts on DWI, unlike cholesterol granuloma.

concepts.name: Cholesterol granuloma vs cholesteatoma
concepts.blurb: T1 signal is the key: granuloma is T1 hyperintense, cholesteatoma is T1 hypointense with DWI restriction.

concepts.name: Petrous apex lesion differential
concepts.blurb: Includes cholesterol granuloma, cholesteatoma, mucocele, apex effusion, apicitis, and chondrosarcoma.

concepts.name: Petrous apex lesion management
concepts.blurb: Symptomatic cystic lesions are drained/marsupialized; epidermoids require resection while incidental lesions are observed.

concepts.name: CSF leak etiologic classification
concepts.blurb: Traumatic, iatrogenic, and spontaneous categories differ in site, pressure dynamics, and repair urgency.
acgme: Skull Base Fractures - CSF Rhinorrhea Otorrhea Pneumocephalus

concepts.name: Beta-2 transferrin testing
concepts.blurb: Beta-2 transferrin (and beta-trace protein) confirm CSF in nasal or ear fluid with high specificity.

concepts.name: CSF leak site localization
concepts.blurb: High-resolution CT for bony defects, MR cisternography, and intrathecal fluorescein localize the fistula.

concepts.name: Spontaneous CSF leak and IIH
concepts.blurb: Spontaneous leaks reflect underlying intracranial hypertension; addressing CSF pressure prevents repair failure.

concepts.name: CSF leak repair strategy
concepts.blurb: Conservative measures and lumbar drainage first; persistent leaks need endoscopic multilayer or open repair.

concepts.name: Meningitis risk in CSF leaks
concepts.blurb: Persistent leak carries cumulative ascending meningitis risk; prophylactic antibiotics are not routinely indicated.

concepts.name: CSF otorrhea
concepts.blurb: CSF from the ear (or through the eustachian tube as rhinorrhea) signals temporal bone or tegmen defects.
acgme: Skull Base Fractures - CSF Rhinorrhea Otorrhea Pneumocephalus

concepts.name: Skull base encephalocele
concepts.blurb: Herniation of meninges and brain through a skull base defect, often with CSF leak, requiring multilayer repair.

concepts.name: Esthesioneuroblastoma
concepts.blurb: Olfactory neuroepithelial malignancy arising at the cribriform plate, often with a dumbbell shape across the skull base.

concepts.name: Kadish staging
concepts.blurb: Kadish A-D stages esthesioneuroblastoma by nasal, sinus, intracranial, and metastatic extension.

concepts.name: Sinonasal carcinoma basics
concepts.blurb: Squamous cell carcinoma and sinonasal undifferentiated carcinoma (SNUC) are aggressive anterior skull base malignancies.

concepts.name: Sinonasal malignancy management
concepts.blurb: Endoscopic or craniofacial resection with negative margins plus adjuvant chemoradiation per histology and stage.

concepts.name: Frontotemporal-orbitozygomatic approach
concepts.blurb: FTOZ adds orbital and zygomatic osteotomy to a pterional craniotomy, widening upward viewing angles to the parasellar region.

concepts.name: Anterior petrosectomy (Kawase)
concepts.blurb: Subtemporal extradural drilling of Kawase's quadrilateral opens the petrous apex to upper clivus and petroclival lesions.

concepts.name: Posterior petrosal approaches
concepts.blurb: Retrolabyrinthine, translabyrinthine, and transcochlear presigmoid corridors trade hearing for petroclival exposure.

concepts.name: Translabyrinthine approach
concepts.blurb: Sacrifices hearing to expose the IAC and CPA with early facial nerve identification; for non-serviceable hearing.

concepts.name: Retrosigmoid approach
concepts.blurb: Versatile suboccipital corridor to the CPA allowing hearing preservation for tumors of any IAC extent.

concepts.name: Middle fossa approach
concepts.blurb: Extradural temporal approach for hearing preservation in small intracanalicular tumors with limited CPA extension.

concepts.name: Far lateral and transcondylar approach
concepts.blurb: Condylar drilling extends the suboccipital corridor to ventral foramen magnum and lower clivus lesions.

concepts.name: Transoral vs endoscopic odontoidectomy
concepts.blurb: Endoscopic endonasal odontoidectomy avoids tongue retraction and palatal splitting versus the classic transoral route.

concepts.name: Extended bifrontal/subfrontal approach
concepts.blurb: Bilateral subfrontal corridor for large anterior cranial fossa lesions like olfactory groove meningioma.

concepts.name: Cavernous sinus anatomy and contents
concepts.blurb: Venous channel transmitting the carotid and CN VI internally with III, IV, V1, V2 in its lateral wall.
acgme: Sellar and Parasellar Anatomy - Pituitary Cavernous Sinus Optic Chiasm

concepts.name: Cavernous sinus syndrome
concepts.blurb: Multiple ipsilateral cranial neuropathies (III, IV, V1/V2, VI) with proptosis localize a cavernous lesion.

concepts.name: Cavernous sinus lesion differential
concepts.blurb: Meningioma, schwannoma, carotid aneurysm, carotid-cavernous fistula, and metastasis populate the differential.

concepts.name: Cavernous sinus management philosophy
concepts.blurb: Conservative debulking with radiosurgery is favored over radical resection given cranial nerve and carotid morbidity.

concepts.name: Carotid-cavernous fistula
concepts.blurb: Arteriovenous shunt into the cavernous sinus causing pulsatile proptosis, chemosis, and ocular bruit.

concepts.name: Optic nerve sheath meningioma
concepts.blurb: Tram-track enhancing meningioma of the optic nerve sheath; radiotherapy preserves vision better than surgery.

concepts.name: Optic pathway glioma
concepts.blurb: Pilocytic astrocytoma of the optic nerve/chiasm, strongly associated with NF1; often observed or treated with chemotherapy.

concepts.name: Orbital and orbital apex lesion differential
concepts.blurb: Meningioma, glioma, cavernous venous malformation, lymphoma, and inflammatory pseudotumor differ by location and signal.

concepts.name: Orbital surgical approaches
concepts.blurb: Lateral orbitotomy, transcranial frontotemporal, and endonasal medial routes selected by lesion quadrant and apex involvement.

concepts.name: House-Brackmann grading
concepts.blurb: Grades I-VI quantify facial nerve function from normal to total paralysis, standardizing outcome reporting.

concepts.name: Bell's palsy vs neoplastic facial palsy
concepts.blurb: Acute, self-limited Bell's contrasts with slowly progressive, recurrent, or twitching palsy that signals a tumor.

concepts.name: Facial nerve schwannoma
concepts.blurb: Schwannoma along any CN VII segment causing progressive palsy or twitching; management preserves function over cure.

concepts.name: Facial reanimation basics
concepts.blurb: Hypoglossal-facial and masseteric transfers, cable grafts, and static slings restore tone after irreversible CN VII injury.

concepts.name: Cranial nerve intraoperative monitoring
concepts.blurb: Free-running and triggered EMG of CN VII and lower cranial nerves guides safe skull base tumor dissection.
acgme: Neurophysiology of Intraoperative Monitoring (SSEP MEP EMG ABR)

concepts.name: Auditory brainstem response monitoring
concepts.blurb: Intraoperative ABR tracks cochlear nerve integrity during hearing-preservation CPA surgery via wave V latency.

concepts.name: CSF diversion in skull base surgery
concepts.blurb: Lumbar drains and EVDs relax the brain, lower CSF pressure on repairs, and protect reconstructions postoperatively.
